name: Harbour & Hale Barbers
tagline: Sharp cuts, clean fades and proper hot towel shaves in the heart of Bristol.
description: Harbour & Hale is a barber shop on Market Street, Bristol, offering men's haircuts, skin fades, beard trims, hot towel shaves and kids' cuts. Walk in or call ahead.
mapsQuery: Harbour & Hale Barbers, 14 Market Street, Bristol BS1 1AA

services.name: Classic Haircut
services.description: Scissor or clipper cut to your preferred style, finished with a neck shave and styling product.

services.name: Skin Fade
services.description: Fade taken down to the skin and blended into the length you want on top.

services.name: Haircut & Beard Trim
services.description: Any haircut plus a full beard shape-up with clean lines and a straight-razor finish.

services.name: Beard Trim & Shape
services.description: Beard trimmed to length, shaped and lined up, finished with beard oil.

services.name: Hot Towel Shave
services.description: Traditional straight-razor shave with pre-shave oil, hot towels and a cooling balm.

services.name: Buzz Cut
services.description: One clipper length all over, tidied at the neckline and around the ears.

services.name: Kids' Cut (under 12)
services.description: Haircut for children under 12, any style.
